title: Understanding CORS
description: Learn what CORS is and why it matters for full-stack apps.

data.text:
**Understanding CORS**

CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) is a security mechanism that allows servers to control which origins can access their resources.

Browsers enforce the Same-Origin Policy (SOP), which prevents a web page from making requests to a different origin than the one that served the page. CORS relaxes this policy safely by allowing servers to specify who can access their resources.

items: Preflight request: OPTIONS request sent by browser for complex requests
Simple request: GET, HEAD, POST with safe headers
Credentials: cookies, authorization headers, TLS certificates
